summary: The updater's ownership proof no longer stays pending, and the sign-in front always matches the release.

fixes.title: Ownership proof no longer stays pending
fixes.text: The updater checks its app registration ownership proof up to six times, so a slow directory answer no longer leaves it pending.

fixes.title: Sign-in front matches the release
fixes.text: An opted-in installation always builds the sign-in front at this release's version, never a newer shared one.
